messages.content:
[1] אי (dictionary form אי) = "if"
  1. אִי II — = אִין; h. אִם; cmp. אוֹ); if, whether; adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II
  2. אִי־ — prefix, v. אִ־
  3. א (via אִי־) — Aleph, the first letter of the alphabet, interchanging with other gutturals, e.g. אבב, הבב, חבב, עבב; אליתא, ע
  4. א ² (via אִי־) — often used to form second roots of verbs ע"ע, e.g. אטם, טמם
  5. א ³ (via אִי־) — frequ. prosthetic, e.g. אגודל, גודל, v. אִ־
  6. א ⁴ (via אִי־) — sometimes inserted to replace a radical, as באגא = בגא, esp. in verbs ע"ו, as דָּאִיךְ fr. דּוּךְ, קָאִים fr. 
  7. א ⁵ (via אִי־) — frequ. (in Talm. Y.) dropped in the beginning of words, e.g. בָּא = אַבָּא; מַר = אֲמַר
  8. א ⁶ (via אִי־) — affixed to the end of Chald. nouns, corresponding to prefixed ה in Hebrew (status emphaticus), e.g. אַבָּא = ה
  9. אִ־ (via אִי־) — &c. a prefix; for the formation of nouns in Kal, Peel, Afel (Hifil) &c., e.g. אִסְפְּקָא, אִיסְ׳, אַפְטָרָה, אַפְטַרְתָּא &c; demonstrative, e.g. אִיהוּ = h. הַהוּא; אִנָּא, אִינָא &c; euphonic (prosthetic) אִדְמָא = דְּמָא; אִית = h. יֵשׁ &c., esp. before foreign words beginning with two conso
  10. אַ־ (via אִי־) — a prefix (followed by Dagesh Forte) = עַל upon, over, e.g. אַמָּרָא = עַל מָרָא; even before gutturals, e.g. א
  11. אִי I — fem. of אוּ q. v
  12. אִי III — = h. אֵין) not. Git. IV

[2] דבלאו (dictionary form בלא) = "that without"
  1. בָּאלָא — = h. בּוּל, cmp. יְבוּל) growth (of grass); whence prairie, pasture ground (in mountains &c.; cmp
  2. בָּלָא — v. בָּאלָא
  3. בַּלָּא — destroyer, v. בִּלְעָם
  4. בִּלְעָם (via בַּלָּא) — b. h.) pr. n. m. Balaam, the gentile prophet of the Pentateuch
  5. בְּלָא — to be worn out, v. בְּלֵי
  6. בלי (via בְּלָא) — (no English given)
  7. בלי ² (via בְּלָא) — v. בלל; cmp. נבל) to be crumbled; to be worn out, to fail, decay, perish; Pi. to wear out, outlive, survive; Nif. Nithpa. נִתְבַּלָּה to become outworn, fade away
  8. בְּלֵי I (via בְּלָא) — Pa. as preced. Pi
  9. בְּלִי (via בְּלָא) — v. preced. ws.) prop. destruction, naught; not; v. בְּלִימָה
  10. בְּלֹא — without, v. לֹא, לָא
  11. לֹא (via בְּלֹא) — v. לַאי) not, no
  12. לָא I (via בְּלֹא) — (no English given)

[3] איהו (dictionary form איהו) = "him"
  1. אִיהוּ — אִיהִי f. (= הוּ, הִי, v. אִ־) he, himself; she, herself

[4] לא (dictionary form לא) = "not"
  1. לֹא — v. לַאי) not, no
  2. לָא I — (no English given)
  3. לָא II — preced. wds.) particle, mote. Yoma
  4. חַרְגָּא (via לָא II) — constr. חַרְגַּת (חרג, v. P. Sm
  5. חִרְגָּא (via לָא II) — v. preced.) [saw-dust,] sun-motes (cmp. נָסַר). Yoma
  6. לָא III — La, abbrev. of אִילָא, הִילָא; v. Fr. M’bo, p

[5] אזלא (dictionary form אזל) = "it would spread"
  1. אֲזַל I — to be gone, to leave; to go
  2. אֲזַל II — = עזל; v. Ezek. XXVII
  3. זוּל I (via אֲזַל II) — v. זָלַל) to be of slight value, to be cheap; to be despicable, mean; low, mean; spendthrift, glutton. Sifré; Hif. to become cheap, fall in price; Hif. to treat with contempt. Treat. Der. Er. ch. II מְזִילֵי הרבים those who treat the public &c; Hof. to fall in price
  4. זוּל (via אֲזַל II) — perf. זָל, Part. זִיל, זוֹל; to disregard; to be worthless, cheap; Af. to sell cheap, make easy terms; Ithpe. to be degraded, disgraced
  5. זוּל II (via אֲזַל II) — cmp. אֲזַל II) to spin
  6. זוֹל (via אֲזַל II) — זוּל I) low price
  7. אַזְלוֹיָא (via אֲזַל II) — foreg.) weaver. Pl. אַזְלוֹיֵי

[6] פשיטא (dictionary form פשיטא) = "it is obvious"
  1. פְּשִׁיטָא — c. (preced.); explanation, teaching.—Pl. פְּשִׁיטִין; plain, self-evident truth; is it not a matter of course?; fem.) Ps’hiṭa, a small coin

[7] אלא (dictionary form אלא) = "rather"
  1. אֶלָּא — contr. of אִן לָא = אִם לֹא); if not, except, but, only; ellipt.) (you cannot say anything except …) but, a logical inference excluding all other explanations &c
  2. אֵלָא — buttress, v. אֵילָא
  3. אֵילָא (via אֵלָא) — trnsf. beak of a ship (a beam to which the head of a ram was attached), prow; projection from a lateral wall, buttress, &c; cmp. אַיִּל
  4. אַיָּלָא (via אֵלָא) — (no English given)
  5. אִילָא (via אֵלָא) — Ila; a Tannai; an Amora. Yoma
  6. אִילָּא (via אֵלָא) — v. אֶלָּא
  7. אֲלָא I — to lament, v. אלי
  8. אלי I (via אֲלָא I) — to curse. Sifré
  9. אלי II (via אֲלָא I) — = ילל, v. אִילְיָא) to lament, wail; Pa. same
  10. אֱלִי (via אֲלָא I) — mourning, v. אַלְיָתָא and אַלִּיתָא
  11. אֲלָא II — club, bat
  12. אַלָּתָא (via אֲלָא II) — = h. אַלָּה) post, pole, door-post

[8] מאי (dictionary form מאי) = "what"
  1. מַאי — = מא הי) what?; why?
  2. אִי־ — prefix, v. אִ־
  3. א (via אִי־) — Aleph, the first letter of the alphabet, interchanging with other gutturals, e.g. אבב, הבב, חבב, עבב; אליתא, ע
  4. א ² (via אִי־) — often used to form second roots of verbs ע"ע, e.g. אטם, טמם
  5. א ³ (via אִי־) — frequ. prosthetic, e.g. אגודל, גודל, v. אִ־
  6. א ⁴ (via אִי־) — sometimes inserted to replace a radical, as באגא = בגא, esp. in verbs ע"ו, as דָּאִיךְ fr. דּוּךְ, קָאִים fr. 
  7. א ⁵ (via אִי־) — frequ. (in Talm. Y.) dropped in the beginning of words, e.g. בָּא = אַבָּא; מַר = אֲמַר
  8. א ⁶ (via אִי־) — affixed to the end of Chald. nouns, corresponding to prefixed ה in Hebrew (status emphaticus), e.g. אַבָּא = ה
  9. אִ־ (via אִי־) — &c. a prefix; for the formation of nouns in Kal, Peel, Afel (Hifil) &c., e.g. אִסְפְּקָא, אִיסְ׳, אַפְטָרָה, אַפְטַרְתָּא &c; demonstrative, e.g. אִיהוּ = h. הַהוּא; אִנָּא, אִינָא &c; euphonic (prosthetic) אִדְמָא = דְּמָא; אִית = h. יֵשׁ &c., esp. before foreign words beginning with two conso
  10. אַ־ (via אִי־) — a prefix (followed by Dagesh Forte) = עַל upon, over, e.g. אַמָּרָא = עַל מָרָא; even before gutturals, e.g. א
  11. אִי I — fem. of אוּ q. v
  12. אִי II — = אִין; h. אִם; cmp. אוֹ); if, whether; adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II

[9] קא (dictionary form קא) = "(particle of ongoing action)"
  1. קָא — abbrev. of קאם, v. קָאֵים a. קוּם) [he, it stands,] a particle of emphasis, mostly untranslatable

[10] עביד (dictionary form עבד) = "did he do"
  1. עֲבַד I — corresp. to h. עָשָׂה); to do, labor; to make; to act; to do, fare, prosper; to spend time; Pa. to make, produce; Pa. to cause to prosper; Pa. to work through. Part. pass. מְעַבַּד, מְעַבְּדָא; Ithpe. to be done; to be made, become
  2. עָבַד — b. h.) [to work; to serve, work for; to prepare; to till the ground; to dress (hides); v. עֲבוֹדָה) to use esp. for idolatrous purposes; to worship; Nif. to be prepared, dressed; Nif. to be used, esp. for illicit purposes; to be worshipped; Nithpa. same, v. supra; Hif. to enslave, oppress; Pi. to prepare, esp. to dress
  3. עֶבֶד — preced. wds.) slave, servant
  4. עֲבַד — same; worshipper
  5. עֲבִיד — v. עֲבַד I, II

[11] מתקיף (dictionary form תקף) = "objects"
  1. תּוֹקֶף — strength, power
  2. תָּקַף — to seize, overpower; with על) to rest heavily upon, be hard
  3. תְּקַף — to seize, hold firmly; to be strong, become powerful; to be heavy, rest heavily upon, be hard; with רוגזא, or sub. רוגזא) to be vehement, hot, excited; Pa. cmp. חזק); Pa. to strengthen; to repair; to harden (the heart of); Pa. to seize, force; Pa. v. תַּקִּיף) to be strong &c., v. supra; Af. to grow strong; Af. to stre
  4. תֹּקֶף — v. תּוֹקֶף, תּוּקְפָא
  5. תְּקֵיף — v. תְּקֵף
  6. תַּקִּיף — strong, powerful. Sifré
  7. תַּקִּיף ² — strong, mighty; protector; hard, stern, severe

[12] לה (dictionary form הוא) = "to it"
  1. הוּא — b. h.) he, it; she; it is &c
  2. הוּא ² — ch. same
  3. הֲוָא — v. הוי
  4. הֲוֵי (via הֲוָא) — fut. יֶהֱוֵי, יְהֵא, יְהֵי ch; same; to dwell upon, discuss, v. infra; Pa. הַוֵּא; Pa. to produce; Pa. also Peel) with ב or על to dwell upon, to discuss, argue, oppose, cmp. קים
  5. הוֹי (via הֲוָא) — b. h.) woe!, ah!
  6. הוי (via הֲוָא) — b. h.) to exist; to be, become; to occur, come to pass.—With part. ה׳ מביט he looked; ה׳ אומר he said, freq. u; frequent, usual; existing, enduring; Pi. v. הְוָיָה; Pi. to change one’s legal status, to dispose of; Pi. to produce, make

[13] רב (dictionary form רב) = "Rav"
  1. רַב I — large, great; much
  2. רַב II — preced.); superior, master; teacher
  3. רַב — large, great, numerous; senior; chief, master, teacher

[14] פפא (dictionary form פפא) = "Pappa"
  1. פַּפָּא — tradit. pronunc. פָּפָּא) pr. n. m. Pappa (Papa), name of several Amoraim
  2. דּוּן (via פַּפָּא) — v. דִּין
  3. דְּוָן (via פַּפָּא) — v. דְּוָון
  4. פַּפָּא II — N’har Pappa, name of a canal and of a place in Babylonia

[15] והא (dictionary form הא) = "but behold"
  1. הָא I — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  2. הָא II — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  3. הֵא II — He-He
  4. הִא III — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  5. הָהּ (via הִא III) — interj.) ah, alas!
  6. הֵה (via הִא III) — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate

[16] איכא (dictionary form איכא) = "there is"
  1. אִיכָּא — contr. of אִית־כָּא); there is, there are (sunt qui). א׳ דאמרי (abbrev. א"ד.) some say; he who
  2. אֵיכָא — = אֵי a. כָּא) where now? (ubinam)
  3. אֵיכַן (via אֵיכָא) — אֵי־כַּאַן, v. אֵיכָא) where? also relat. where, &c

[17] הא (dictionary form הא) = "this"
  1. הָא I — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  2. הָא II — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  3. הֵא II — He-He
  4. הִא III — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  5. הָהּ (via הִא III) — interj.) ah, alas!
  6. הֵה (via הִא III) — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate

[18] דתניא (dictionary form תני) = "that was taught"
  1. תְּנֵי — to repeat, do a second time; to tell, relate; to teach; Pa. to change; Pa. to tell, relate; to teach; Af. to stipulate, agree, make a condition; Af. to relate, teach; Ithpe. to be repeated; Ithpe. to be told, reported
  2. תני — v. שָׁנָה) [to repeat,] to tell; Pi. same; Hif. to stipulate, agree, make a condition
  3. תְּנֵי II — cmp. שנן) to be pointed, sharp; Pa. to sharpen, to speak sharp words; Ithpe. to be sharpened

[19] שישבו (dictionary form ישב) = "who sat"
  1. יָשַׁב — b. h.); to sit down, rest; to dwell, remain; to be inactive. Macc. III; to be settled (v. יִישּׁוּב), be inhabited; Pi. to settle, put in place, to arrange evenly; Pi. to settle, cultivate, populate; Hif. to seat, place, appoint; to settle. Yoma; Nif. to be inhabited. Pirké d’; Hithpa. Nithpa. נִתְיַישֵּׁב; Hithpa. to 
  2. יְשַׁב — Ithpa. אִתְיַישַּׁב, contr. אִיַּישַּׁב as preced. Hithpa

[20] על (dictionary form על) = "on"
  1. עֹל — v. עוֹל
  2. עוֹל (via עֹל) — imperat. of עֲלַל
  3. עוּל (via עֹל) — interch. with עֲלַל); to come, come in. Perf. עָל, עָאל; part. עָל, עָאֵיל, עָאֵל, עָיֵיל; to bring in; Pa. to come in habitually. Inf. מְעַיֵּיל, v. מֵעֲלָא; Pa. to bring in, insert; Pa. to produce, develop, ripen; Ithpa. to insert one’s self; to get in. Yoma; Af. Ittaf. אִיתָּעַל, Ithpe. אִתְעַל, v. עֲלַל
  4. עוֹל ² (via עֹל) — yoke; also pole of a wagon
  5. עָוַל (via עֹל) — b. h.), Pi. עִוֵּול, עִיוֵּל (denom. of עָוֶל) to act perversely; to do wrong, cheat
  6. עָוֶל (via עֹל) — perversion, fault
  7. עַל — height; (prepos.) upon, above; about &c.—With suff. (pl.) עָלַי, עָלֶיךָ &c
  8. עַל ² — (no English given)
  9. טוּף (via עַל ²) — to shine,] to come to the surface, float, bubble up. Part. טָאֵיף, טָיֵיף; denom. of טיף) to drip; to be inundated; Pa. to direct the overflow, to assign channels; Pa. to cause to glisten, to turn in all directions; Pa. to cause to float, v. infra; Af. fr. נְטַף); Af. to make flow; Af. to cause to float; Ithpa. to be g
  10. עָל — verb, v. עוּל, עֲלַל
  11. *עָל — cmp. עִילָא II) plan
  12. עֵל — v. עֵיל

[21] ספסל (dictionary form ספסל) = "bench"
  1. סַפְסָל — v. סֵפֶל; frame, bench, stool

[22] אחד (dictionary form אחד) = "one"
  1. אֶחָד — אַחַת f. (b. h.; v. next w., one. [Freq. represented by א׳; singular, unique; cmp. אֲחַד) closed up, mysterious
  2. אָחַד — sec. r. of חוּד, v. חוּד I) to join, close. Part. pass. אָחוּד, pl. אֲחוּדִים; closed up, mysterious; joined, united
  3. אֲחַד — Pa. אָחֵיד, אַחֵד ch. (v. foreg.); corresp. to h. סגר a. תפש; cmp. h. אחז) to close (the door), to lock up; to seize, capture; to devote, v. אֲחִיד; Af. to seize; Ithpe. to be seized; Ithpe. to be locked up, joined

[23] ולא (dictionary form לא) = "and not"
  1. לֹא — v. לַאי) not, no
  2. לָא I — (no English given)
  3. לָא II — preced. wds.) particle, mote. Yoma
  4. חַרְגָּא (via לָא II) — constr. חַרְגַּת (חרג, v. P. Sm
  5. חִרְגָּא (via לָא II) — v. preced.) [saw-dust,] sun-motes (cmp. נָסַר). Yoma
  6. לָא III — La, abbrev. of אִילָא, הִילָא; v. Fr. M’bo, p
  7. וָלָא — v. וָאלִי; P. Sm
  8. וָאלִי (via וָלָא) — ואל, cmp. b. h. יָעַל a. הוֹאִיל) propriety. לא ו׳ it is unbecoming

[24] שברוהו (dictionary form שבר) = "they broke it"
  1. שֵׂבֶר — v. סֵבֶר
  2. סְבַר (via שֵׂבֶר) — with אַפִּין) to show a bright face, be pleasant; to favor (with ב or ל); to be bright, intelligent; to look out for, hope; to speculate, plan; to imagine, believe; to conclude, argue, understand; to have an idea; Pa. to look for, hope, trust; Pa. with אַפִּין) to favor; Af. to trust; Af. to make confident; Af. with אַ
  3. סָבַר (via שֵׂבֶר) — Pi.; Saf. of ברר) [to be bright,] to look for, be hopeful; to think, imagine. Part. pass. סָבוּר; f. סְבוּרָה;; Hif. to brighten, illustrate, make clear
  4. סְבַר II (via שֵׂבֶר) — Poël סוֹבַר (cmp. סבל) [to encompass,] to carry; to bear, endure; to sustain
  5. סְבַר III (via שֵׂבֶר) — Poël סוֹבַר (Saf. of ברי; cmp. Arab. sabar exploravit vulnus &c., misbâr specillum vulnerarium) to perforate, 
  6. סַבַּר (via שֵׂבֶר) — סְבַר I) reasoner, fine scholar
  7. סֵבֶר (via שֵׂבֶר) — hope; with פָּנִים, brightness, friendly expression; in gen. countenance; understanding, plain sense
  8. סְבַר IV (via שֵׂבֶר) — hope; with אפִּין, countenance; opinion
  9. סְבָר (via שֵׂבֶר) — preced.); brightness of mind, ingenuity; speculation, logical argument; common sense, ordinary conception, opp. עיקר
  10. שְׂבַר — Poël שׂוֹבַר, v. סְבַר II
  11. שָׁבַר I — b. h.); to break; Pi. to break; Hof. to be broken; Hithpa. Nithpa. נִשְׁתַּבֵּר same
  12. שָׁבַר II — to buy provisions; Hif. to sell provisions, to supply

[25] ובא (dictionary form בא) = "and came"
  1. בָּא I — = אַבָּא); father; pr. n. m. Ba = Abba
  2. *בָּא II — = בֵּיתָא, house
  3. בָּא III — part. of בֹּוא) coming, future. עולם הַבָּא (abbr. עו"הב) the world to come, futurity
  4. ובא — (no English given)
